title: backlog drain #1: 6 rows closed on live evidence, 6 refusals recorded (508 -> 504 unresolved)
body:
## Backlog drain #1 — `health-review-backlog.json`

Drain session, not a review: the job was **closing** rows, not finding new ones. Every closure below was verified against the **live fleet** or by making a guard **actually fail** — none on a code citation alone.

### Burn-down (population stated)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Denominator** | `docs/claude/health-review-backlog.json`, **508 unresolved** at `origin/main` (321 `open` + 187 `kept_open`) out of 1,077 rows |
| **Examined** | 14 rows read in full against their own `resolution_criteria` |
| **CLOSED** | **6** |
| **REFUSED** | **6** (annotated in place with evidence, status unchanged) |
| **FILED** | **2** (found while verifying) |
| **After** | **504 unresolved** / 1,079 rows — **net −4** |

Diff is **133 insertions / 14 deletions** across a 4.9 MB file: 14 rows touched, no reformat. Written through `detect_format` (`indent=2, ensure_ascii=False`), re-verified byte-for-byte after each write.

`python3 scripts/ci/run_guards.py --base main` → **PASS 32 · FAIL 0 · SKIP 35**, run on the **committed** tree.

---

### CLOSED (6) — with the evidence that closed each

**1. `BL-20260901-DB-EXPLORER-IS-UNGATED-AND-REACHES-DEVICE-TOKENS-RAW-TOKEN-COLUMN`** *(high)*
`/api/diag/version` puts the serving web-api on `0e90202f` — the fix's own sha, so the code under test is the code running.
- (a) unauthenticated `GET /api/bot/db/table/device_tokens` → **HTTP 404** `{"detail":"unknown table: device_tokens"}`; `/api/bot/db/tables` lists 21 and `device_tokens` is not among them.
- (b) the inversion: `/api/diag/db_info` confirms `device_tokens` **is** in the live schema, so the 404 is a refusal and not a missing table. **Positive controls:** `trades` and `insights_usage` both → 200.
- (c) docstring premise corrected; default-deny enforced at one chokepoint (`_federated_tables`).

**2. `BL-20260901-NO-PRE-MERGE-GUARD-ON-BACKLOG-ROUND-TRIP`** *(high)*
Guard registered at `scripts/ci/run_guards.py:415`. The row said a green run does **not** close it — so I planted an `indent=3 / ensure_ascii=True` serialisation in a scratch root and `check_live_backlogs` returned **exit 1** with the `::error::` naming the file. **Shown to fail**, not shown to pass.

**3 + 4. `BL-20260831-STRAY-OCA-APPLY-PATH-HAS-NO-SOAK…` / `…-ANNOTATE-COMPUTES-A-VERDICT-AND-DISCARDS-IT`** *(medium ×2)*
`git show --stat 2f4600c5` confirms writer **and** diag allowlist in one commit. `/api/diag/log_file?name=stray_oca_soak` returns a real **apply-mode cancel** on `ib_paper`/MGC (2026-09-01T14:32:35Z): `acted: true`, `verify_state: verified`, `still_resting: []`, `confirmed_gone: [perm:1502161097, perm:1502161096]`, all five leg states with explicit zeros summing to `legs_seen`. `run_probes.py --check` passes with the `decision=stray_unkeyed AND acted=true` probe.

**5. `BL-20260830-FANOUT-SOAK-GRADES-A-NO-WINNER-TICK-AS-STARVED`** *(high)*
`lines=1000` returned **73 rows** — the complete file, not a tail. **0 of the 60 `fanout_schema: 2` rows** grade a winnerless tick as starved. The three counters ship separately (`starved_count` >0 on 2, `no_winner_count` >0 on 15, `winner_unattributed_count` >0 on 0). The 13 pre-schema rows are correctly retained as the version marker — **do not pool them**: 17 of the 19 raw `starved` gradings sit there, reproducing the original ~6.5× overstatement.

**6. `BL-20260830-PAIRS-SOAK-RECORDS-NO-POSITION-IDX-SO-HEDGE-MODE-CANNOT-BE-VERIFIED`** *(high)*
Live `open` row 2026-09-01T05:01:07Z, SOLUSDT/ETHUSDT, `bybit_1`, live: both legs `placed: true` with `position_idx` 1/2 **and `position_idx_state`** beside it, so null-for-`one_way` and null-for-`unresolved` stay distinguishable.

> ⚠️ **FOR THE MANAGER — this row also makes `OI-20260830-BYBIT-HEDGE-MODE-ARMED-BUT-UNEXERCISED` gradeable, and all three of its criteria read off that single row:** (1) `position_idx` 1/2 on both legs, never 0; (2) both `placed`, and the last `half_open` **anywhere** is 2026-09-01T00:02:52Z — *before* the open — with none for that pair after; (3) `directional_open: present` on the SOL leg, i.e. the netting collision that causes stranding was actually there, which that row calls "the whole criterion". **I did not clear it** — `OPEN-ITEMS.json` is outside my declared scope and four sibling sessions were live.

### Honest caveats on the closures
- **#4**: the one live row is `mode: apply`; that the *annotate* path also writes is read from code (`record()` sits outside the mode branch, `ib_client.py:1829-1846`), not observed. The criterion asks for "a graded row for ib_paper MGC or MHG" and does not require annotate mode.
- **#4/#3**: the criterion names `OI-20260831-STRAY-OCA-SWEEP-ARMED-ON-IB-PAPER-BUT-HAS-NEVER-CANCELLED`. **No such row exists** (checked all 29). The probe it describes lives on `OI-20260826-STRAY-OCA-SWEEP-SHIPPED-BUT-UNARMED` with `probe_absent_reason: None`. Satisfied in substance under a different id.
- **#6**: only 2 of the 4 `position_idx_state` values were sampled; `one_way`/`unresolved` emission is inferred from code.
- **#1**: column redaction is unexercised **by construction** (no request reaches a non-allowlisted table) — correct, not a gap.

---

### REFUSED (6) — so the next session does not re-derive them

| Row | Why not closed |
|---|---|
| `BL-20260830-BUILDER-EXCEPTION-LATCH-HAS-NEVER-BEEN-WRITTEN` | **Still `present: false`** 12 days on. Positive control: 4 other soak logs returned `present: true` on the same route in the same session. And the condition is **live right now** — an `ict_scalp_mgc_15m` no-candle warning banner since 22:12:42Z. So the writer is not merely unexercised; a burst is happening and nothing is written. |
| `BL-20260901-PROP-FILLS-STALENESS-FILTERS-ON-A-MUTABLE-REPORTED-AT…` | **One read short.** (a) verified in code. (b) banner **gone** and latch `findings: {}` — but that check ran 22:49:09Z, ~4 min *before* the current process started (22:53:04Z, uptime 1169 s), and one cadence window has not elapsed on it. **After ~23:53Z:** re-read `prop_fills_staleness_state` — if `__last_check__` is past 22:53:04Z and `findings` is still `{}`, (b) is met outright. |
| `BL-20260901-ORDER-PACKAGES-SINCE-WITH-A-RAW-PLUS-OFFSET…` | **Reproduced live.** `since=…+00:00` → `count: 0`; `since=…Z` → `count: 2`. Same window, opposite answers, no `filter_state`. |
| `BL-20260831-DIAG-JOURNALCTL-CAPS-AT-1000-LINES…` | **Reproduced live**, and it **cost a closure**: `lines=400&since=22:00:00Z` returned 1 min 44 s of a 72-min window (2.4%), unmarked — the exact window needed to date the trader restart for the row above. |
| `BL-20260825-THREE-BYBIT-MODIFY-TESTS-FAIL-ONLY-UNDER-A-PARTIAL-SELECTION` | **Not checkable here.** The named selection hits 345 collection errors bare, 33 after installing deps — all `pyo3_runtime.PanicException` from pydantic-core (ABI mismatch). I did **not** `--ignore` them: the row's subject *is* the partial selection, so a green under a mutilated one answers a different question. Needs CI or the project venv. |
| `BL-20260825-KEPT-OPEN-ROWS-WITH-NO-EXIT-CONDITION-CAN-NEVER-BE-RETIRED` | The one true **class** here, selected first for that reason. Criterion 1 is ~55 findings to re-establish (the row forbids boilerplate); criterion 2 touches `ROADMAP.md`, out of scope with siblings live. **Criterion 3 — a diff-scoped guard refusing a new `kept_open` row with no exit condition — is the tractable, compounding half**, and Phase C sharpened its target: widening from `kept_open` to all 576 carried rows adds **zero**, so the guard need only police the *transition into* `kept_open`. Recorded as a refusal, not as re-validation. |

---

### FILED (2)

- **`BL-20260901-BACKLOG-ROUND-TRIP-GUARD-COVERS-3-OF-4-LIVE-BACKLOGS`** *(medium)* — `LIVE_BACKLOGS` names 3 paths; 4 review backlogs exist. `research-review-backlog.json` is unguarded, and the backlogs are excluded from `pytest-run`'s relevance filter, so a break there reaches `main` green. Its criterion refuses a one-line fix.
- **`BL-20260901-DRAIN-CANDIDATES-DIAG-SIGNAL-CHECKS-THE-ALLOWLIST-NOT-THE-FILE`** *(low)* — the tool's surviving `diag_log_name` signal proves only that a name is in `_LOG_FILES`. It shortlisted `BUILDER-EXCEPTION-LATCH-HAS-NEVER-BEEN-WRITTEN` as `likely_met` — the row whose entire finding is that the file does not exist. Right answer for the wrong reason on 2 of 3; wrong answer on 1 of 3.

### Note on the class-first mandate
The skill is right that class-first beats row-first, and I selected that way. The health backlog's unresolved set does not currently contain a class with ≥2 members and one structural fix that a **drain** session may enact — the one real class is the `kept_open` row above, whose tractable half is a CI guard I judged out of scope while a sibling session held CI-adjacent work. Recording that rather than reporting six unrelated closures as if they were a class retirement.
